objectiveContext.raw_user_goal:
CD-4: Research the safe OpenAPI compatibility adapter contract

Define the oasdiff-backed OpenAPI adapter rather than creating another API-diff engine. Choose the baseline strategy, exact supported inputs, version pinning, normalized finding shape, and safe execution posture.

The adapter compares a checked-in YAML/JSON contract from a candidate checkout with the same path at an explicit baseline Git ref. Consumer request/response fixture validation is valuable but is a separately scoped follow-up, not a V1 claim.

h2. Acceptance criteria

* An ADR pins an oasdiff version/image and records the supported OpenAPI versions, command contract, severity/ignore ownership, and baseline Git-ref strategy.
* The ADR specifies no-shell execution, read-only temporary inputs, timeout/output caps, and disabled external $ref resolution for untrusted inputs.
* The ADR defines normalized OpenAPI findings with severity, check ID, locator, message, fingerprint, and base/candidate provenance.
* A fixture matrix covers no change, removed operation, optional-to-required field, enum/constraint break, invalid spec, missing baseline, timeout/tool failure, and ignored/reclassified finding.
